quarter.zh: 2027 财年第一季（9 月季度）

en: Revenue rose 137% to $1.26B, just above the ~$1.25B consensus, and non-GAAP EPS of $4.57 beat ~$4.22 and the top of guidance. Systems revenue more than tripled to $508M on optical circuit switches; components rose 99% on pump lasers. The Q2 guide of $1.575–1.625B and $5.90–6.20 EPS was well above the ~$1.49B and ~$5.0 expected. CEO Michael Hurlston cited a second NPO/CPO win backed by over $5B of commitments and said OCS could become a multi-billion-dollar business.

Results came out before the open on Nov 2 alongside Marvell's all-stock bid of 4.5 Marvell shares each, worth $1,132 at Oct 28 prices. Shares rose about 3% premarket but closed down 18.6% as Marvell fell 12.7%. Stifel and B. Riley downgrades and a post-election AI-chip selloff took the stock to $509.70 on Nov 5, 39% below its pre-report close. It then rebounded with Marvell and optical peers, closing Nov 9 at $596.16, still 12.9% below the first-session close.
zh: 营收增长 137% 至 12.6 亿美元，略高于约 12.5 亿美元的预期；非 GAAP 每股收益 4.57 美元，高于约 4.22 美元的预期及指引上限。系统业务受光路交换机带动增长逾两倍至 5.08 亿美元，器件业务受泵浦激光器带动增长 99%。第二季指引营收 15.75–16.25 亿美元、每股 5.90–6.20 美元，远高于约 14.9 亿美元和约 5.0 美元的预期。CEO 迈克尔·赫尔斯顿称公司拿下第二个 NPO/CPO 大单，采购承诺逾 50 亿美元，并表示 OCS 有望成为数十亿美元级业务。

业绩于 11 月 2 日盘前发布，同时宣布 Marvell 以每股换 4.5 股 Marvell 股票的全股票方式收购，按 10 月 28 日股价计每股值 1,132 美元。股价盘前涨约 3%，但因 Marvell 当日跌 12.7%，收盘跌 18.6%。随后 Stifel 和 B. Riley 下调评级，叠加大选后 AI 芯片股抛售，11 月 5 日股价跌至 509.70 美元，较财报前收盘低 39%。此后随 Marvell 及光通信同业反弹，11 月 9 日收于 596.16 美元，仍较财报后首日收盘低 12.9%。

bio.en: CEO since February 2025 after five years running Synaptics. Spent most of his career at Broadcom, where he led the wireless and mobile connectivity businesses. Has refocused Lumentum on AI data-center optics: lasers, transceivers and optical circuit switches.
bio.zh: 2025 年 2 月出任 CEO，此前执掌 Synaptics 五年。职业生涯大部分在博通，负责无线与移动连接业务。上任后将 Lumentum 重心转向 AI 数据中心光器件：激光器、光模块和光路交换机。

bio.en: CFO since February 2019. Previously CFO of Synaptics, vice president and controller of Teledyne Technologies, and CFO of DALSA, a public chipmaker that Teledyne acquired.
bio.zh: 2019 年 2 月起任 CFO。此前任 Synaptics CFO、Teledyne Technologies 副总裁兼财务总监，以及被 Teledyne 收购的上市芯片公司 DALSA 的 CFO。

sources.t: Q1 FY27 results and Q2 guide (Lumentum IR)
Nov 9 rebound with Marvell and optical peers (Yahoo Finance)
